items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I saw him in the subway two months before he got popular with that... I saw that guy on the subway and thought, that's just another freak, and then I see him on TV.

ctx.x: Your dad just said you can't kill us all; you can't make us stop. So don't you think that ...
Well, regardless of what he does, or she does, I do -- oh, jazz will exist forever. (simultaneous talk)

Another thing that helps to confuse what we're talking about, like we were talking about making a living, making money from this, and I was saying earlier about the rock movement going down in record sales. But you never know when gimmicks will come up, just like when Tiny Tim came up singing 'Tiptoe Through the Tulips,' in a falsetto voice, and he was the toast of the country with a gold record.
